description: Scala source file containing utility functions for working with PipelineAnalysisContext in Spark SQL connect module.

classes.name: PipelineAnalysisContextUtils
classes.description: Object providing utility methods for handling PipelineAnalysisContext within user context.

methods.name: getExtensionList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of extensions of a specific Message type from a buffer of ProtoAny extensions.

methods.name: getPipelineAnalysisContextList
methods.description: Extracts PipelineAnalysisContext extensions from a UserContext.

methods.name: hasPipelineAnalysisContext
methods.description: Checks if the user context contains any PipelineAnalysisContext extensions.

methods.name: isInsidePipelineFlowFunction
methods.description: Determines if the current execution is within a pipeline flow function based on user context.

methods.name: isUnsupportedEagerExecutionInsideFlowFunction
methods.description: Checks if eager execution inside a pipeline flow function is unsupported based on plan type.
